notes.title: Map Pack DLC is Live!
notes.notes:
A map pack DLC for Divine Ascent has been released, which adds 18 new levels to the Arena mode.

Everyone who already owns the base game got the DLC pack for free. As for the newcomers, there is a 40 percent discount on it, so don't miss it!

Divine Ascent:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/606300/Divine_Ascent/

Divine Ascent - Map Pack DLC:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/682950/Divine_Ascent__Map_pack/

Absorb Reality Collection:

http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/3186/Absorb_Reality_Collection/

notes.title: New languages supported by Divine Ascent
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Two new languages are now available in our latest game Divine Ascent : Russian and German, which add up to the already existing English, French, and Spanish. 

No reason not to understand its twisted rules anymore. Check the game out if you haven't already, and become the master builder of the ancient world.

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/606300/Divine_Ascent/] Divine Ascent Steam page [/url]
